item.description: - NDAI, which looks after your Desk, can now read every conversation on it, including direct messages. The app says so wherever it used to call a line private: "Only you, M2 and NDAI see this". - For NDAI on the Executive Desk: Everyone's lines lists every person's lines on a member Desk, opened read-only. - Opening a Desk after switching never shows "That conversation isn't yours to read." It goes to your chief of staff instead.
